storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content: She dances within the embrace of green flames, their dim flickering light falling across the dancer's young, devotion-filled face. With every turn, the emerald fire ignites the souls of the wicked, burning away every impurity upon the stage.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
A.F. 31@1, December, the police received a report from the manager of the second theater in @2 Garden. The reporter claimed that there had been four small-scale fires in the theater within a week, and rumors of the "Ballet Ghost" were rampant among the members of the dance troupe renting the theater.

To ensure the smooth premiere of the ballet "Swan's Lament," the police launched a joint investigation with the West District Fire Department.

The day before the performance, Mythag University finally took over the investigation. The investigators noted traces of Gnosis residue behind several fire points. Eventually, Investigator @3 discovered an Awakener in the underground ruins of the second theater.

This Awakener was not a mindless individual; she identified herself as "Liz." After communication, the Awakener Liz eventually admitted to her arson crime. After the premiere of "Swan's Lament," Investigator @3 took Liz back to Mythag University for formal incorporation.

According to historical records, when the fire broke out at the second theater in @2 Garden on A.F. 29@1, a ballet was being performed. Among those who perished in the flames were a number of nobles in the audience, as well as a young prima ballerina named "Elizabeth Sur."

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Liz is a reliable Awakener; although her attitude cannot be called "enthusiastic", she shows considerable cooperation with all school affairs.

The only concern is that, though Liz spends every night in the dance classroom, no one has seen her true dance performance.

As an excellent ballet dancer, Liz's name has appeared in several related publications. Unfortunately, due to the impact of the D-phenomenon, the information department of the awakening system could only determine that Liz had stepped onto the stage of the second theater in A.F. 29@1.

School reporter Hannah Peasley proposed gathering dance enthusiasts on campus, using their passion for dance to "open Awakener Liz's heart".

Currently, this proposal has yet to be approved by the Awakener Management Office.

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Day 45 of joining the dance troupe. I stood on stage as the lead performer.

The scorching lights struck the hem of my skirt, and the tiny diamonds scattered a dazzling brilliance across the air. The glare made it hard to see, but the thunderous applause told me that my performance shone brighter than any gem.

In endless spinning, all the dust of the world is purified by the dance, and the beauty of art is carried out to every corner. This is my wish and my mission as a dancer—

But who are those people lurking in the dark corners beneath the stage?

Lisette, the girl known for her carefree and upright nature—why is she whispering with that notorious lord?

Angelica, the genius who always looks down on the other dancers—why is she lifting her skirt for that infamous playboy?

Such disgrace... such filth! Oh God, my muse, tell me—what must I do to guard my stage from the darkness? What light is needed to dispel this filth—

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
This is the Promised Land, an artistic utopia, the ultimate paradise—dance should be the dancer's home, kept in eternal purity.

So long as I burn, filth cannot taint our Church... This is my mission, my hope... Let me burn brightly, and I shall cleanse away all impurity, for everyone.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: You provided me with a place to stay, and I am grateful. But forgive me, I no longer deserve to stand upon the stage again.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: Keep improving your composure.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Are my movements accurate enough?

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: Fouette. Twenty more times.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: This reminds me of the first pair of red dancing shoes I received when I was eight. I really love them. Thank you, Keeper.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: Close your eyes and tell me, what do you see? Immaculate moonlight, a tranquil lake...

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: Even if my heart holds no more longing, I will still play the role of the swan.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: It is the yearning for life that drives the swan to struggle for its return to the distant sky.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: No matter how you struggle, you cannot defy fate. But that fleeting moment of brilliance will be frozen into eternity.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: I will include your name in my acknowledgments. It is you who allowed these feet, tainted by dark blood, to step into the wonderful world of ballet once more. From now on, please watch me dance, Keeper.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: Do you want me to take the stage and shine? That's impossible now. These eyes have been consumed by hatred. All I can do is burn everything to ashes.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Do you understand that feeling? Spinning, spinning, spinning, never stopping. Knees stretched to the limit, toes bleeding black, soaking the ballet shoes, yet never pausing. All because I refuse to accept the fate of being a mere toy...

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: I didn't burn skilled court dancers, graceful ballet masters, or nobles who appreciate beauty. I burned useless fools selling their bodies, sycophants disregarding others, and filthy beings lost in lust... You understand me, right?

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: The devout dancer is dead, and the blasphemer of art is also dead, both perished in flames filled with the scent of tar. Death is not the end but the beginning, for only humans die; dance and art are eternal.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: Thank you for your understanding. Perhaps now is the time to reconcile with my past self... I believe I am doing the right thing and have not disgraced my family's legacy in dance. I will step onto the stage you have prepared and shine as you wish.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Do you also wish to be consumed by the green flames?

daily.title: Chat: About Dancing
daily.content: Dance is pure. Words may lead to misunderstandings, but dance steps never do.

daily.title: Chat: About Tinct
daily.content: Tinct... Hearing her mournful song makes me want to dance...

daily.title: Chat: About the Flames
daily.content: Rumor has it that bodies twitching in the flames appear as if they are dancing...

daily.title: Chat: About Dissolution
daily.content: Wait a minute... I've seen this before. They fed me water with this black goo in it. Could it be related to my gaining the power of the Green Flame? I suppose it is a blessing in disguise.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: My life revolves around dance. Learning other knowledge is difficult for me to grow. But everyone here is kind; they won't sell me out for vanity or money—I can feel it.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: "The Dying Swan," a performance in which the dancer uses body language to convey the longing and struggle of life. Isn't that twisted figure in the flames the same?

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: "The Nutcracker" is supposed to be a romantic fairy tale for girls, but those repulsive individuals only saw the graceful limbs in motion and vulgar desires... Disgusting.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: Are you here to save me? From the decaying world, from the hatred that stains my eyes, from the eternal green flames...

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: May the irreverent be dissolved in this searing tranquility.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: We will all become... part of the Green Flame...

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: Now I grant you eternal life!

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Here I present, the Dance to Destruction of the Eternal Green Flame!

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Sink and burn! Dance to destruction!
